attributes.action: Make e-bikes legal for people to ride and less strict rules on them
attributes.background: Let people ride e bikes on public roads and remove the rule of them being crushed or auctioned off and only take the bikes when people are being reckless because e-bikes are one of the reasons kids can go out and have fun outside and not stay inside on social media

rejection.details:
Some e-bikes are already legal to ride on public roads.

You may be interested in these two petitions:

Legalise and regulate e-scooters & e-bikes exceeding current limits for road use
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/765825

Update UK e-bike laws: allow 750W, 20mph limit and throttle use
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/760021
